contextAboutMe.description1: This is where BearlyMail stores everything it learns about you—your priorities, important contacts, current projects, and more.
contextAboutMe.description2: The more context you provide, the smarter your email prioritization becomes! Think of it as training your personal AI assistant.
contextAboutMe.impactTitle: How Context Affects Your Email Priority
contextAboutMe.impactDescription: Context directly influences how emails are scored for urgency. VIP contacts get priority boosts, emails matching your goals are ranked higher, and topics you don't care about are deprioritized. This helps you focus on what truly matters.

tooltip.vip: Emails from these contacts will receive a significant priority boost. Add people you always want to respond to quickly—like your manager, key clients, or close colleagues.
tooltip.userInfo: Information about you that helps BearlyMail draft better replies. This includes your role, preferences, and any details that personalize your communication style.
tooltip.projects: Current projects and topics you're actively working on. Emails related to these will be prioritized based on the priority level you set (high, medium, or low).
tooltip.urgent: Keywords or topics that signal urgency to you. When emails contain these terms, they'll be marked as higher priority.
tooltip.notImportant: Topics or keywords that you don't want to prioritize. Emails containing these will be deprioritized to help you focus on what matters.
tooltip.qanda: Common questions you receive and your standard answers. This helps BearlyMail draft more accurate replies by referencing your typical responses.
tooltip.other: Miscellaneous context that doesn't fit other categories. Use this for any additional information that helps personalize your email experience.

help.title: Help & Documentation
help.description: Learn how to get the most out of BearlyMail. Browse articles below or use contextual help links throughout the app.

context.title: Understanding Context
context.description: Learn how context works and how it affects your email prioritization.

section0.title: What is Context?
section0.content: Context is information about you that BearlyMail uses to prioritize your emails intelligently. The more context you provide, the better your email prioritization becomes.

section1.title: Types of Context
section1.content: BearlyMail uses several types of context to understand your priorities:
section1.item0: VIP Contacts: People whose emails should always get high priority
section1.item1: User Info: Information about you used for drafting personalized replies
section1.item2: Current Projects: Topics you're actively working on with priority levels
section1.item3: Urgent Keywords: Terms that signal urgency to you
section1.item4: Not Important: Topics you want to deprioritize
section1.item5: Q&A: Common questions and your standard answers

section2.title: How Context Affects Priority
section2.content:
Context directly influences the priority score of each email:

• VIP contacts receive a +25 priority boost
• Goal-aligned emails get up to +20 points
• Current projects boost priority by +5 to +15 depending on priority level
• Emails matching 'not important' topics are penalized by -20 points

This scoring system helps surface the emails that matter most to you.

section3.title: Getting Started
section3.content: To build your context, click 'Analyze Emails' in Settings. BearlyMail will scan your email history to automatically identify VIP contacts, common topics, and patterns. You can also manually add context items to fine-tune your prioritization.

triage.title: Using Triage Mode
triage.description: Learn how to quickly sort through new emails and decide what needs attention.

section0.title: What is Triage?
section0.content: Triage mode is where new emails land. This is your first stop for processing incoming messages. Quickly decide what to do with each email: reply, archive, or snooze.

section1.title: Quick Actions
section1.item0: Star emails that need action (moves them to Action mode)

section2.title: Priority Scores
section2.content: Each email shows a priority score based on your context. Higher scores indicate emails that are more important to you. Click on the score to see why it was prioritized.

section3.title: Best Practices
section3.content:
• Process triage in batches during your scheduled delivery times
• Use stars liberally—you can always unstar later
• Trust the priority scores, but don't hesitate to override when needed
• Archive anything you know you won't need

process.title: Processing Emails in Action Mode
process.description: Learn how to efficiently handle emails that need action.

section0.title: What is Action Mode?
section0.content: Action mode contains all emails you've starred. This is your focused workspace for emails that need a response or action from you.

section1.title: Working Through Your Action List
section1.item0: Process emails one by one or in batches
section1.item1: Use AI summaries to quickly understand email content

section2.title: AI Features
section2.item0: Generate email summaries in various formats
section2.item1: Draft replies based on your writing style
section2.item2: Check tone to match your communication preferences

section3.title: Staying Focused
section3.content: Action mode is designed to help you focus. Work through starred emails systematically, and avoid jumping back to triage until you've cleared your action list.

followUp.title: Managing Follow-ups
followUp.description: Understand how the Follow Up tab helps you track emails waiting for responses.

section0.title: What is Follow Up Mode?
section0.content: Follow Up mode shows emails where you sent the last message and are waiting for a reply. This helps you track conversations that need follow-up.

section1.title: When Emails Appear Here
section1.content: An email appears in Follow Up mode when:
section1.item0: You sent the last message in a thread
section1.item1: No reply has been received yet

section2.title: Following Up
section2.item0: See which conversations are waiting for responses
section2.item3: Track which emails need your attention

section3.title: Bulk Follow-ups
section3.content: You can generate and send multiple follow-up messages at once. BearlyMail will draft personalized follow-ups for each thread, which you can review and send individually or in bulk.

search.title: Searching Your Emails
search.description: Learn how to find emails quickly using BearlyMail's search functionality.

section0.title: How Search Works
section0.content: BearlyMail uses AI-powered search to find emails based on meaning, not just keywords. This means you can search for concepts, topics, or ideas rather than exact words.

section1.title: Search Tips
section1.item0: Use natural language queries (e.g., 'emails about the budget meeting')
section1.item1: Search for topics or concepts, not just keywords
section1.item2: Review the relevance scores to find the most relevant emails
section1.item3: Use search explanations to understand why results matched

section2.title: Relevance Scores
section2.content: Each search result shows a relevance score indicating how well it matches your query. Higher scores mean better matches. Click on a result to see why it was included.

section3.title: Limitations
section3.content: Search results are limited to emails that have been processed by BearlyMail. Very recent emails or emails that haven't been synced may not appear in results immediately.

settings.title: Settings Overview
settings.description: Learn about all the settings and configurations available in BearlyMail.

section0.title: Email Batching
section0.content: Configure when emails are delivered to you. Set delivery days and times to batch emails and reduce distractions. Urgent emails can bypass the schedule.

section1.title: Tone Settings
section1.content: Define how you want to write emails. BearlyMail learns from your sent emails and can enforce tone rules when drafting replies.

section2.title: Summarization Rules
section2.content: Create custom rules for how emails should be summarized. For example, extract only action items from meeting requests, or summarize newsletters in bullet points.

section3.title: Context Management
section3.content: Manage your context—VIP contacts, current projects, urgent keywords, and more. Click 'Analyze Emails' to automatically learn context from your email history, or add items manually.

section4.title: Blocked Senders
section4.content: Block emails from specific senders. Blocked emails won't appear in your inbox, helping you focus on what matters.

section5.title: API Key (Optional)
section5.content: Use your own OpenAI API key for AI features. If not provided, the system default key will be used. Your key is encrypted and stored securely.
